text:
Hold ###input.INPUT_QUICK_ACCESS_RADIAL_LEFT### to display the quick access slots.
Upon release, the highlighted weapon is equipped. Consumables are used immediately.
zh:
按住###input.INPUT_QUICK_ACCESS_RADIAL_LEFT###可显示快捷栏。
松开后，将装备高亮的武器。消耗品则会立即使用。

text: With ###input.quick_access_slot### you can navigate through your quick access slots.
zh: 使用###input.quick_access_slot###可在快捷栏之间切换。

text: Skills can be placed into quick access slots from the skills tab in the player window.
zh: 可在玩家窗口的技能页签中将技能放入快捷栏。

text: Hold ###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR### to open the skill quick bar and switch between available skills.
zh: 按住###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR###可打开技能快捷条，并在可用技能之间切换。
